name: Maritima Malcolmia
original_name: マリティマ・マルコルミア
source:
A werewolf maid who used to serve the Embroche family. She is not a familiar spirit so she can exist even after [url=/c39402]Shuuma[/url]'s father is gone. While Mari was searching for Shuuma to revive the Embroche family again, [url=/c34612]Iris[/url] found her and began using her as a gofer.

She is disappointed that Shuuma is not dependable as either a master or vampire. Still, she is serving him as a houseworker, hoping the Embroche family will someday be revived. Mari says whatever she thinks and sometimes it is too direct and poisonous towards her master Shuuma, basically though she is obedient and nice. She gets wolf ears and a tail when surprised.

[From [url=http://prefundia.com/projects/view/libra-of-the-vampire-princess-bishoujo-game-english-version/6962/]Prefundia[/url]]
